1354typedef struct sChannelScanResults {

1366 int32_t signal_strength_dBm;

1368 eChannelScanResultSecurityMode security_mode_enabled[beerocks::message::CHANNEL_SCAN_LIST_LENGTH];
1369 //The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises. Enumerate List.

1371 //Indicates the frequency band at which the radio this SSID instance is operating. Enumerate
1372 eChannelScanResultOperatingFrequencyBand operating_frequency_band;
1373 //List items indicate which IEEE 802.11 standards thisResultinstance can support simultaneously, in the frequency band specified byOperatingFrequencyBand. Enumerate List
1374 eChannelScanResultStandards supported_standards[beerocks::message::CHANNEL_SCAN_LIST_LENGTH];

1376 eChannelScanResultStandards operating_standards;
1377 //Indicates the bandwidth at which the channel is operating. Enumerate
1378 eChannelScanResultChannelBandwidth operating_channel_bandwidth;
1379 //Time interval (inms) between transmitting beacons.
1380 uint32_t beacon_period_ms;
1381 //Indicator of average noise strength (indBm) received from the neighboring WiFi radio.
1382 int32_t noise_dBm;
1383 //Basic data transmit rates (in Kbps) for the SSID.
1384 uint32_t basic_data_transfer_rates_kbps[beerocks::message::CHANNEL_SCAN_LIST_LENGTH];
1385 //Data transmit rates (in Kbps) for unicast frames at which the SSID will permit a station to connect.
1386 uint32_t supported_data_transfer_rates_kbps[beerocks::message::CHANNEL_SCAN_LIST_LENGTH];
1387 //The number of beacon intervals that elapse between transmission of Beacon frames containing a TIM element whose DTIM count field is 0. This value is transmitted in the DTIM Period field of beacon frames. [802.11-2012]
1388 uint32_t dtim_period;

1391 //This indicates the number of station associated with the BSS. This field is taken from BSS Load IE of scanned bss.

1408 tlvf_swap(32, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&(supported_data_transfer_rates_kbps[i])));
1409 }
1410 tlvf_swap(32, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&dtim_period));
1411 tlvf_swap(32, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&channel_utilization));
1412 tlvf_swap(16, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&station_count));
1413 tlvf_swap(32, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&load_bss_ie_present));
